title: How to Enable Full-Width Homepage Content
text:
## How to Enable Full-Width Homepage Content
Link: https://support.brilliantdirectories.com/support/solutions/articles/12000079053
In order to display the Homepage Streaming Content full-width please follow these steps:
1. Navigate to My Content -> Web Page Builder:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181972707/original/s1ZjYZfaqSkqG32tf5N2UJF62XqP9rhC0Q.png?1783981316 | alt: ]
2. Search for the Homepage and click on Edit:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181972723/original/pjYKmbJnCWU6P911C7LqZMFwButHTKS3DA.png?1783981338 | alt: ]
3. Move to Page Options Tab on the sidebar and select the Full Screen Page Width option:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12181972740/original/yJcmKw5ltGcwrwv12ZjZnb0XF56FSV-RWQ.png?1783981368 | alt: ]
4. Save the changes.
This is what the Homepage streaming content will look like after enabling this setting:
[IMAGE: https://s3.amazonaws.com/cdn.freshdesk.com/data/helpdesk/attachments/production/12124823238/original/pSSkVYzO0wT9mcXNwufHDh8_4cetDE75Ew.jpeg?1682979659 | alt: ]
